pictures.name: PA1-Exile-River
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich hand-woven textiles, deep blue shadows and warm gold lamplight, soft painterly brushwork, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, no letters, no logos, no modern objects. Exiles from Jerusalem sitting on the banks of a wide slow river in Babylon at dusk, men, women and elders in worn, dusty robes, harps hung on the branches of willows, mud-brick ziggurat and city walls far on the horizon. Faces tired and homesick, looking west toward home. Deep blue evening, last gold light on the water. Longing.

pictures.name: PA2-Old-Stories

No text, no letters, no logos, no modern objects. Inside a small mud-brick house in Babylon at night, a family of exiles gathered around one oil lamp; a grandfather with a white beard tells a story with his hands raised, the children and adults listening, faces lit gold. On the wall behind them, their shadows. Memory, the good old days. Warm and wistful.

No text, no letters, no logos, no modern objects. A gathering of exiles in a dusty courtyard in Babylon at dawn, faces turned up, listening intently. pictures.name: PA6-Today
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows and warm gold lamplight, soft painterly brushwork, main subject in the middle of the frame. A modern setting painted in the same contemplative oil style, warm light, no readable text, no logos. A modern kitchen at morning. A young woman stands by the window holding a mug, eyes closed for a moment, then looking out at a small green seedling sprouting in a pot on the windowsill, sunlight falling on it. Calm, letting go, noticing something new.
